# ip_occupancy = frappe.db.sql("""SELECT * FROM `tabInpatient Occupancy`;""", as_dict=True)
ip_occupancy = frappe.db.sql("""SELECT * FROM `tabInpatient Occupancy` WHERE `left`=0;""", as_dict=True)

if ip_occupancy:
    for ipo in ip_occupancy:
        if ipo.parent:
            ip = frappe.get_doc("Inpatient Record", ipo.parent)
            if ip.status == "Admitted":
                service_unit_type = frappe.get_doc(
                    "Healthcare Service Unit Type",
                    frappe.db.get_value("Healthcare Service Unit", ipo.service_unit, "service_unit_type")
                )

                item_code = service_unit_type.item_code
                item_group = service_unit_type.item_group

                # Admission and current times
                admission_time = ip.admitted_datetime
                current_time = frappe.utils.now_datetime()

                # Calculate total time difference in hours
                total_time_difference_hours = frappe.utils.time_diff_in_seconds(current_time, admission_time) / 3600
                
                # Generate sales invoice only if admitted for more than 23 hours
                if total_time_difference_hours > 23:
                    patientinfo = frappe.get_doc("Patient", ip.patient)
                    patient = ip.patient
                    patient_name = ip.patient_name
                   
                    customer = patientinfo.customer
                   
                    rate = service_unit_type.rate
                    desc = service_unit_type.description
                    remark = ipo.service_unit
                    practitioner = ip.admission_practitioner
                
                    is_insurance = 0
                    if ip.insurance:
                        is_insurance = 1
                    # Create and submit sales invoice
                    salesdoc = frappe.get_doc({
                        "patient": patient,
                        "patient_name": patient_name,
                        "customer": customer,
                        "is_pos": 0,
                        "is_insurance": is_insurance,
                        "insurance" : ip.insurance, 
                        "so_type": "Cashiers",
                        "due_date": frappe.utils.getdate(),
                        "remarks": remark,
                        "posting_date": frappe.utils.getdate(),
                        "doctype": "Sales Invoice",
                        "ref_practitioner": practitioner,
                        "cost_center": "Main - AIH",
                        "items": [
                            {
                                "item_code": item_code,
                                "item_name": ipo.service_unit,
                                "description": desc,
                                "warehouse": "Pharmacy",
                                "qty": 1,
                                "rate": rate,
                                "income_account": "Admission - AIH",
                                "bed": ipo.service_unit,
                                "doctype": "Sales Invoice Item",
                            }
                        ],
                    })
                    try:
                        salesdoc.insert()
                        salesdoc.submit()
                    except Exception as e:
                        frappe.log_error(f"Failed to create sales invoice for patient {patient}: {e}")

script:
# Server Script # Script Type: DocType Event # Reference Doctype: Purchase Order # DocType Event: On Update STATE_MAP = { "Accountant Approval": { "roles": ["Finance Officer"], "notify_owner": False, "headline": "Approved by the Accountant. Awaiting Finance Officer review.", }, "Finance Officer Approval": { "roles": ["Director"], "notify_owner": False, "headline": "Approved by the Finance Officer. Awaiting Director approval.", }, "Director Approval": { "roles": ["Director"], "notify_owner": True, "headline": "Awaiting final sign-off from the Director.", }, "Approved": { "roles": ["Accountant", "Finance Officer", "Purchase Manager"], "notify_owner": True, "headline": "This purchase order has been fully approved.", }, "Rejected": { "roles": [], "notify_owner": True, "headline": "This purchase order has been rejected.", }, "Cancelled": { "roles": [], "notify_owner": True, "headline": "This purchase order has been cancelled.", }, } PRINT_FORMAT = "Purchase Order" # States that must never trigger an email, no matter what. # Pending is the initial state - the requester already knows they raised it. NO_EMAIL_STATES = ["Pending"] before = doc.get_doc_before_save() config = STATE_MAP.get(doc.workflow_state) # GUARD 1 ----------------------------------------------------------- # On a second save within the same request, get_doc_before_save() # returns None. Without this check previous_state becomes None, the # "state changed" test passes again, and a duplicate mail goes out. state_changed = bool(before) and before.workflow_state != doc.workflow_state previous_state = before.workflow_state if before else None # GUARD 2 ----------------------------------------------------------- # Belt and braces: if anything was already queued for this document # in the last 2 minutes, assume it was this same transition. recently_queued = False if state_changed: cutoff = frappe.utils.add_to_date(frappe.utils.now(), minutes=-2) recently_queued = bool(frappe.get_all( "Email Queue", filters={ "reference_doctype": doc.doctype, "reference_name": doc.name, "creation": [">", cutoff], "status": ["in", ["Not Sent", "Sending", "Sent"]], }, limit=1, )) if ( config and state_changed and not recently_queued and doc.workflow_state not in NO_EMAIL_STATES ): # --- recipients ------------------------------------------------- candidates = [] for role in config["roles"]: for user in frappe.get_all( "Has Role", filters={"role": role, "parenttype": "User"}, pluck="parent", ): if user not in candidates: candidates.append(user) if config["notify_owner"] and doc.owner not in candidates: candidates.append(doc.owner) recipients = [] if candidates: for user in frappe.get_all( "User", filters={"name": ["in", candidates], "enabled": 1}, pluck="name", ): if "@" in user and user not in ("Administrator", "Guest"): recipients.append(user) if recipients: # --- attachments -------------------------------------------- attachments = [] for file_id in frappe.get_all( "File", filters={ "attached_to_doctype": doc.doctype, "attached_to_name": doc.name, }, pluck="name", ): attachments.append({"fid": file_id}) # Only attach the PDF if the print format really exists, # otherwise sendmail raises and the whole transition fails. if frappe.db.exists("Print Format", PRINT_FORMAT): attachments.append({ "print_format_attachment": 1, "doctype": doc.doctype, "name": doc.name, "print_format": PRINT_FORMAT, "lang": "en", }) # --- body --------------------------------------------------- link = frappe.utils.get_url("/app/purchase-order/" + doc.name) from_state = previous_state or "New" currency = doc.get("currency") or "" # NOTE: no "+=" anywhere in this file - RestrictedPython blocks # augmented assignment in Server Scripts (_inplacevar_ is undefined). row_parts = [] for row in (doc.get("items") or []): item = row.get("item_name") or row.get("item_code") or "" qty = row.get("qty") or "" uom = row.get("uom") or "" rate = frappe.utils.fmt_money(row.get("rate") or 0, currency=currency) amount = frappe.utils.fmt_money(row.get("amount") or 0, currency=currency) row_parts.append( f"{item}" f"{qty}" f"{uom}" f"{rate}" f"{amount}" ) rows = "".join(row_parts) items_table = "" if rows: items_table = ( "

Items

" "" "" "" + rows + "
ItemQtyUOMRateAmount
" ) supplier = doc.get("supplier_name") or doc.get("supplier") or "" grand_total = frappe.utils.fmt_money( doc.get("grand_total") or 0, currency=currency ) schedule_date = frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.get("schedule_date")) \ if doc.get("schedule_date") else "—" message = f"""

{config["headline"]}

Purchase Order{doc.name}
Supplier{supplier}
Required By{schedule_date}
Grand Total{grand_total}
Status{from_state} → {doc.workflow_state}
Raised by{frappe.db.get_value("User", doc.owner, "full_name")}
{items_table}

Open the purchase order

""" frappe.sendmail( recipients=recipients, subject=f"[{doc.workflow_state}] Purchase Order {doc.name}", message=message, attachments=attachments, reference_doctype=doc.doctype, reference_name=doc.name, now=False, )
